recent_posts.title: The Valley of Code is back
recent_posts.summary: Flavio Copes relaunched The Valley of Code, a learning platform he had previously shut down due to managing too many projects. This time, he's consolidating all 1700+ blog posts from his personal site into The Valley of Code with permanent redirects, planning to reorganize the chronological content into structured lessons over time. His personal blog will now focus only on news and updates, while The Valley of Code becomes his primary resource for coding tutorials and educational content.

top_posts.title: The CSS Handbook, 2025 edition
top_posts.summary: Flavio Copes has released an updated 2025 edition of his CSS Handbook, covering modern CSS features like container queries, cascade layers, CSS nesting, and new color spaces. The comprehensive guide spans from fundamentals like selectors and the box model to advanced topics including CSS Grid, responsive design, animations, and best practices for maintainable code.

top_posts.title: The JavaScript Handbook, 2025 edition
top_posts.summary: Flavio Copes has released an updated 2025 edition of his popular JavaScript Handbook, originally published in 2020. The update includes cosmetic improvements, accuracy fixes, modernized async content, better explanations of arrays and objects, clarified arrow function syntax, and consistent coding style choices. The handbook is part of a collection of 20 programming books covering various languages and technologies including CSS, Node.js, React, TypeScript, and more.
